abi.description: A positive requested Landlock ABI version. Values newer than this implementation supports are accepted and clamped to its latest supported ABI.

accessFs.description: A filesystem access right or ABI-relative group. Each concrete right must be supported by the effective policy ABI; groups remain valid at every ABI and resolve to its supported subset. This semantic constraint is enforced by the parser because Draft 7 cannot derive it from the root ABI.

accessNet.description: A network access right or ABI-relative group. Each concrete right must be supported by the effective policy ABI; groups remain valid at every ABI and may resolve empty before network support. This semantic constraint is enforced by the parser because Draft 7 cannot derive it from the root ABI.

scope.description: A scope or ABI-relative group. Each concrete scope must be supported by the effective policy ABI; groups remain valid at every ABI and may resolve empty before scope support. This semantic constraint is enforced by the parser because Draft 7 cannot derive it from the root ABI.

handledAccessFs.description: A positive filesystem access expression or concrete compatibility exception. Every negative item must be covered by an explicitly present positive ABI group in this source and cannot also be explicitly positive. These source-wide semantic constraints are enforced by the parser.

handledAccessNet.description: A positive network access expression or concrete compatibility exception. Every negative item must be covered by an explicitly present positive ABI group in this source and cannot also be explicitly positive. These source-wide semantic constraints are enforced by the parser.

handledScope.description: A positive scope expression or concrete compatibility exception. Every negative item must be covered by an explicitly present positive ABI group in this source and cannot also be explicitly positive. These source-wide semantic constraints are enforced by the parser.

abi.description: The mandatory Landlock ABI version used to resolve access groups and derive omitted ruleset categories.

ruleset.description: Optional overrides for ABI-derived handled and scoped rights. Repeated entries are unioned.

handledAccessFs.description: Handled filesystem rights. If absent from every ruleset entry, all rights supported by the effective policy ABI are handled. Present arrays are unioned, and an empty array suppresses the ABI-derived base. Filesystem rules augment the resulting rights.

handledAccessNet.description: Handled network rights. If absent from every ruleset entry, all rights supported by the effective policy ABI are handled. Present arrays are unioned, and an empty array suppresses the ABI-derived base. Network rules augment the resulting rights.

scoped.description: Scoped rights. If absent from every ruleset entry, all scopes supported by the effective policy ABI are enabled. Present arrays are unioned, and an empty array suppresses the ABI-derived base. Rules do not augment scopes.

pathBeneath.description: Filesystem rules. Their allowed rights augment handled filesystem rights.

netPort.description: Network port rules. Their allowed rights augment handled network rights.
